directive.thread_id: launch-video port 2026-11-04, lane film-tools, the narrator correction renderer

targets.baseline_commit_message: render-a-motion-graphics-overlay, media-composition: a film's correction-insert outputs and still matte, moved byte for byte

preserve: the overlay encode (ProRes 4444, alpha, 16 alpha bits, apl0, bt709), the narrator wav padded by the voice start so 0 s is the overlay's first frame, and the music bed (start, length, fades, exit fade) plus every placed effect mixed into one stem, with the same ffmpeg argv

the S-Log3 freeze plate (one frame at frame/fps less half a frame, looped to the overlay's frame count, ProRes 422 HQ, its comment) and the graded freeze plate (the export frame scaled to 1920x1080, bt709)

the preview: 3 s before the insert from the graded export, the frozen frame under the overlay with the two stems, 3 s after (or none when the film ends), 1080p, or 960x540 with the overlay piped in for a quick preview
a shot is refused before anything is drawn when its claims fail the claim check, and its report is printed
modes full, quick, audio_only and stills, the timeline file, and a shot without an exit refused; a shot lasts until its exit's light leak and its last word are done
the batch drivers: shots rendered one after another under one machine-wide lock at low priority; quick previews copied into a picker folder under the picker's names
allowed_deltas: the claim check is tool:check-every-claim-against-its-facts-and-sources run on the shot (its request in claim_check, or the look row's insert section) instead of the film's fact_gate module
the film's recipe, sound files and music bed come from the person's look row in list:settings, shots from piece rows; paths are read against the request's root and assets
the scratch plate frame is written in the shot's own output folder and removed, not /tmp/narr-plate*.nut shared by every render
the preview encoder is a request field (default h264_videotoolbox, as before; libx264 off a Mac)
command-line flags and the shell drivers (render_all.sh, quick_options.sh) became request fields: mode, stills, specs/spec_records, lock {file, wait_while}, copy_previews_to {folder, names}
the shot's Build is the shared overlay Build (overlay/build.py), whose stage K is again the look's frame height / 1080
a sound the table lacks, or audio_only without the overlay, is refused in words
banned_substitutions: a film's paths, sound files, shot ids or picker names written into the code
a renderer rewritten instead of moved
_paths: The source lives in a private repository, so it is named by the BLAKE3 identity of its path (path_multihash); a checkout of that repository beside this one finds it. Line 795 holds a person's name and is left out of the sources (each source names its lines); the first source (lines 730-794) is the byte copy. Lines 660-663 are the build's exit and duration rule.
